note: N2 'Gloria' anticipation A2, round 3 re-key after the round-2 critics ('profile bust bolted onto a back-view pelvis; head facing left while the glaive thrusts right; tube legs; off-model'). Now a true three-quarter back: shoulders and pelvis turned the same way (only ~15 degrees of spine twist), so the back plane, spine groove, halter yoke and cross read as one surface over the thong-cut seat. The glaive leads forward in the direction she faces (screen left, tilted up ~25 degrees) with both hands on it in front of her body, so the haft passes behind her silhouette cleanly: blade out past her far shoulder, butt out behind the near hip. She looks over her shoulder along the haft (profile). Weight on the far leg, the seat tilts toward it, the near heel lifts. The hair tail swings out to the near side, the veil trails. Round 4 fix (body/overall/gear critics: 'scarecrow T-pose, level spear cuts the figure, profile head, back covered by hair'): root 140 -> 150 (both cheeks + thong V), shoulders twisted ~28 degrees against the hips, head over the left shoulder toward three-quarter (neck/head yaw 42/48); both hands on the haft in front of her (lead hand mid-shaft on a nearly straight arm, rear hand hidden behind the body), the glaive on a ~22 degree diagonal, blade up screen-left, butt out at the right below the shoulders; hair mantle and tail swing to her right so the open back shows.
